items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Both reported false positives allowed; real force pushes to main/master (incl. -f, clusters, --force-with-lease, +refspec, --all/--mirror) still blocked; target taken from push refspecs.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Inspector fails open on any internal error (exit 0); only exit 3 blocks. Unbalanced quotes fall back to a regex split. stdin decoded as utf-8 with replace.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input reaches a shell; command is read from stdin and tokenised with shlex. Guard is still a best-effort denylist, not a sandbox.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Parametrized allow/block cases through the real bash hook plus direct unit tests for no-refspec branch logic and fail-open; independent code review findings each got a regression case.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra python process per Bash call, same order as the existing JSON-extraction call; git rev-parse only on forced pushes without an explicit branch.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Inspector extracted from inline bash to force_push_guard.py so it is unit-testable; no inline-quoting trap.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Hook contract unchanged: exit 2 + JSON additionalContext on block. hooks.json untouched. shared/scripts/hooks/validate_command.sh (unwired sibling) deliberately untouched.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff: no findings after wrapping the existing pytest.skip in a CI-gated pytest.fail.
